data.description:
## What
Write failing tests that assert the affects_fields classifier fixture exists with the required structure and label distribution, and that an accuracy-check script validates the >=95% threshold on the high-stakes class.

## Test file
tests/scripts/test-red-team-affects-fields-classifier.sh

## Test cases
- tests/fixtures/affects-fields-classifier.json exists
- Fixture contains >=100 total labeled examples
- Fixture contains >=50 examples with label 'high_stakes'
- Fixture contains >=50 examples with label 'rationale_only'
- Each entry has required fields: 'decision_text', 'affects_fields', 'label' (high_stakes | rationale_only), 'source_ticket'
- A companion validation script (tests/scripts/validate-affects-fields-accuracy.sh or inline check) exists and exits non-zero when accuracy <95% on high-stakes class
- Running the accuracy check against the fixture produces a result >= 95%

## Gate
RED — tests must FAIL before fixture is created
data.title: RED: test affects_fields classifier fixture schema and accuracy gate contract
